I recently discovered Joe Zampetti and I can say I had a great time! From the very first moment, I received sincere assistance and advice, tailored to my puppy's needs, without the feeling of being overly pushy. You can tell the staff are knowledgeable, helpful, and truly hospitable.

Since it was their first week of operation, I also received a €5 voucher and a few freebies, a much-appreciated gesture.

For me, it's already become a trusted shop: finally, a place where you can find not only dry food, toys, and everything else your pet needs, but also people who listen to you and offer expert, passionate advice. I'll definitely be back!
